title: Catch the Right Thing
prompt: Write fetch_score(data) that returns data["score"] as an int, but returns -1 when the key is missing. Do NOT catch every exception — catch only the one that a missing key raises.

tests.name: missing key handled
tests.code:
assert fetch_score({"score": 7}) == 7
assert fetch_score({}) == -1, "missing key must give -1"
assert "except KeyError" in code, "catch KeyError specifically"
tests.hint: try: return int(data["score"]) / except KeyError: return -1
